Name: Sun Haven Mage Master Set
Author: FrutigerAero101
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Add new Shirts and Accessories to your game (FS)

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
1. Download and install *Fashion Sense*
2. Download this mod and extract the RAR file.
3. Open the extracted folder, 
       + Copy the *Shirts* folder and paste it into the *Local Pack - Shirts* folder inside your Fashion Sense. 
       + Copy the *Accessories* folder and paste it into the *Local Pack - Accessories* folder inside your Fashion Sense.

[b]Requirements[/b]
Fashion Sense

Downloads.Description: Fixed cloak position for sitting and riding.
